final_parent_mechanism.en: Behavioral Trust Region for Agent Updates

terminal_reason.zh: 已实际进入过 P0；后续是实验诊断线，不再退回 Idea-level redesign。
terminal_reason.en: Already entered P0; later work is experiment diagnosis rather than idea-level redesign.

pre_p0_gate.zh: 保留既有 P0 历史；任何重跑仍服从当前冻结的 Pre-Experiment/identifiability 合同。
pre_p0_gate.en: Preserve the existing P0 history; any rerun follows the current frozen Pre-Experiment/identifiability contract.

strongest_baseline.zh: 当前任务收益门控与等预算行为漂移/回归基线。
strongest_baseline.en: Current-task-gain gating and matched-budget behavior-drift/regression controls.

minimum_p0.zh: 保留 A-1 已运行的 P0 artifact 与后续诊断，不重写历史实验。
minimum_p0.en: Preserve the executed A-1 P0 artifact and later diagnostics without rewriting history.

exact_stop.zh: 实验层 stop 由冻结协议决定；单次不可识别 pilot 不等于 Idea-level DROP。
exact_stop.en: Experiment-level stop follows the frozen protocol; a non-identifiable pilot is not an idea-level DROP.

current_fact.zh: A-1 会诊后的 soft-audit repair F0 已收口。只用 36 个 development unit 选 horizon，在 36 个 future_eval unit 冻结验证：branch h=1 召回 2/5 nonzero=40%，成本 624/2813=22.2%；更简单的 development target-family prior 在更低成本 613 steps 下召回 3/5=60%，而 h=1 + navigate→navigate trigger 同为 40% recall 但只需 526 steps。进一步 rescue 也失败：获取完整 first-divergence signature 本身需 236 steps；在同 624-step 总预算下，state_signature 与 target_state_signature 排序都仍只召回 2/5=40%，没有超过 target-family prior。future 仅 1 个 harmful unit，不足以授权 harm-prioritization 主张。决定 STOP_REPAIR_SOFT_AUDIT_SIMPLE_TRIAGE_DOMINATES：早期 branch signal 仅并入科研系统的 soft audit scheduling heuristic，不再为 A-1 standalone repair 消耗 GPU。
current_fact.en: The post-clinic A-1 soft-audit repair F0 is closed. Horizon selection used only 36 development units and was frozen on 36 future_eval units. Branch h=1 recalls 2/5 nonzero effects (40%) at 624/2813 paired-action steps (22.2%). A simpler development target-family prior recalls 3/5 (60%) at a lower 613-step cost, while an h=1 + navigate-to-navigate trigger matches 40% recall at only 526 steps. A final context-signature rescue also fails: acquiring all first-divergence signatures costs 236 steps, and under the same 624-step total budget both state_signature and target_state_signature ranking still recall only 2/5 (40%), below the target-family prior. The future split contains only one harmful unit, so a harm-prioritization claim is not identifiable. Decision: STOP_REPAIR_SOFT_AUDIT_SIMPLE_TRIAGE_DOMINATES. Keep early branch signals only as a research-system soft-audit scheduling heuristic and spend no further GPU on standalone A-1 repair.

terminal_reason.zh: 已有正式 Pilot Registry P0 artifact。366/366 rollout task success=0 使旧结果因 base-agent floor/no identifiability 失效，但不改变已进入过 P0 的生命周期。
terminal_reason.en: A formal Pilot Registry P0 artifact exists. The 366/366 zero-success rollout invalidated the old result because of base-agent floor/no identifiability, but does not undo its P0 lifecycle entry.

pre_p0_gate.zh: 后续重跑先通过当前 Pre-Experiment 可识别性与基座能力门。
pre_p0_gate.en: Any rerun must first clear the current Pre-Experiment identifiability and substrate-competence gates.

strongest_baseline.zh: 同成功容差下的 fixed-1/fixed-2/fixed-4 与 tuned heuristic。
strongest_baseline.en: Fixed-1/fixed-2/fixed-4 and tuned heuristic under the same success tolerance.

minimum_p0.zh: 旧 P0 artifact 作为诊断证据保留；重跑先证明 target variation 与 base-agent competence。
minimum_p0.en: Keep the old P0 artifact as diagnostic evidence; a rerun must first establish target variation and base-agent competence.

exact_stop.zh: 合格基座下仍无可识别最优轮次变化，或简单策略同预算等效，则停止控制器机制主张。
exact_stop.en: Stop the controller claim if qualified substrates still show no identifiable optimal-round variation or matched simple policies are equivalent.

current_fact.zh: A-2 已从“控制 update round”修到“控制 evidence acquisition depth”并完成 CPU repair F0。development-only 搜索得到 per-target-family horizon 策略，在 development 达到 5/6=83.3% nonzero recall、34.3% cost；但冻结 future_eval 上只剩 2/5=40% recall、734/2813=26.1% cost。继续穷举事前可见 conditioning 后，target-family/source-family/source→target relation 三种 adaptive policy 在 future 都只有 2/5=40% recall，成本分别 26.1%/36.9%/43.9%；完全不自适应的 fixed h=1 同样 2/5=40% recall，却只需 624/2813=22.2% cost，逐项严格支配。决定 STOP_REPAIR_FIXED_HORIZON_DOMINATES：evidence-depth scheduling 并入 A-1/系统 soft audit，不启动 A-2 controller GPU training。
current_fact.en: A-2 was repaired from controlling update rounds to controlling evidence-acquisition depth and completed a CPU repair F0. A development-only per-target-family horizon search reaches 5/6 (83.3%) nonzero recall at 34.3% cost on development, but on frozen future_eval it falls to 2/5 (40%) recall at 734/2813 steps (26.1%). Exhausting the pre-observable conditioning choices does not rescue it: target-family, source-family, and source-to-target-relation adaptive policies all reach only 2/5 (40%) future recall at 26.1%, 36.9%, and 43.9% cost respectively. A non-adaptive fixed h=1 reaches the same 2/5 (40%) future recall at only 624/2813 steps (22.2%), strictly dominating every adaptive variant. Decision: STOP_REPAIR_FIXED_HORIZON_DOMINATES. Merge evidence-depth scheduling into A-1/system soft audit and do not launch A-2 controller GPU training.

final_parent_mechanism.zh: 预算校准的预测性回归面板

terminal_reason.en: Learn cross-version marginal probe value, build a core/reserve panel, and adapt K and sequential stopping from predicted hidden-original-task fidelity.

pre_p0_gate.zh: 打开 hidden original tasks 前冻结 panel、threshold 与 stopping rule。
pre_p0_gate.en: Freeze the panel, threshold, and stopping rule before opening hidden original tasks.

strongest_baseline.zh: historical-sensitivity ranking + 相同 K 的 fixed stopping；fixed VaG-style gate。
strongest_baseline.en: Historical-sensitivity ranking plus fixed stopping at the same K; fixed VaG-style gate.

minimum_p0.zh: 跨版本 discovery/calibration 后冻结 core/reserve；隐藏原任务同时评估 accepted/rejected updates 的 fidelity、false-safe 与成本。
minimum_p0.en: Freeze core/reserve after cross-version discovery/calibration; evaluate hidden-original fidelity, false-safe rate, and cost for both accepted and rejected updates.

exact_stop.zh: 固定 K/固定 gate 在同 probe 预算下等效，或 marginal probe value 不能预测 hidden-original fidelity，则停止独立机制。
exact_stop.en: Stop if fixed-K/fixed gating is equivalent at the same probe budget or marginal probe value cannot predict hidden-original fidelity.

current_fact.zh: A-3 当前 prompt-patch P0 实例已触发 substrate STOP：8 个 typed/scoped candidate 仅 1 个正 target gain，effective candidate fraction=12.5%<冻结 40% 门；updater competence 为 block-only FAIL。6-task mastered panel 已冻结并通过，但 fresh candidate×panel×hidden-original fidelity 从未获授权执行，hidden original 未打开。因此 STOP_CURRENT_SUBSTRATE_UPDATER_INCOMPETENT 只停止当前 Qwen2.5-7B+ALFWorld prompt-patch 实例，不授权 A-3 方法 FAIL；若未来重开必须先换成新通过 competence 的 update substrate/action stream。
current_fact.en: The current A-3 prompt-patch P0 instance fires a substrate STOP: among 8 typed/scoped candidates only 1 has positive target gain and the effective-candidate fraction is 12.5%, below the frozen 40% gate; updater competence is a block-only failure. The six-task mastered panel is frozen and passed, but the fresh candidate × panel × hidden-original fidelity test was never authorized and hidden originals were never opened. STOP_CURRENT_SUBSTRATE_UPDATER_INCOMPETENT therefore stops only the current Qwen2.5-7B + ALFWorld prompt-patch instance and does not authorize an A-3 method failure; reopening requires a newly competence-qualified update substrate/action stream.

final_parent_mechanism.zh: 类型化更新交互规则注册表

terminal_reason.en: Pair/order/rollback interventions learn one frozen typed relational registry producing compatibility clauses, no-good constraints, precedence rules, and minimal local repair.

pre_p0_gate.zh: 冻结 update identities、template×surface split、registry 与 zero-test-time-search 解码规则。
pre_p0_gate.en: Freeze update identities, the template×surface split, registry, and zero-test-time-search decoder.

strongest_baseline.zh: set-conditioned order-aware risk model + equal-budget constrained repair search。
strongest_baseline.en: Set-conditioned order-aware risk model plus equal-budget constrained repair search.

minimum_p0.zh: held-out update identities 与 held-out template×surface compositions 上直接预测并 zero-search 修复。
minimum_p0.en: Directly predict and repair on held-out update identities and held-out template×surface compositions with zero test-time search.

exact_stop.zh: 直接 order-aware risk model 或等预算 repair search 追平，或规则只记 identity/template，则停止独立方法。
exact_stop.en: Stop if the direct order-aware risk model or equal-budget repair search ties it, or rules memorize identities/templates.

current_fact.zh: A-4 CPU P0 已触发 frozen matched-simplification STOP：用同一 15 条 typed pair/order intervention table，registry 编译 no-good / precedence / compatibility clauses；matched baseline 只存 ordered descriptor pair 风险表，并在 hidden triple 上做 equal-budget local constrained repair。20 个 held-out triples、全部 update identities 未见，双方 prediction accuracy=1.0、repair success=1.0、逐 case repair agreement=1.0，candidate checks 49 vs 49。typed registry 没有提供超出 direct order-aware risk + repair 的独立价值，建议 merge/drop，等待人工确认。
current_fact.en: A-4 CPU P0 fired the frozen matched-simplification STOP. From the same 15 typed pair/order intervention rows, the registry compiles no-good/precedence/compatibility clauses while the matched baseline stores only an ordered descriptor-pair risk table and performs equal-budget local constrained repair on hidden triples. Across 20 held-out triples with entirely unseen update identities, both reach prediction accuracy=1.0, repair success=1.0, exact per-case repair agreement=1.0, and 49 vs 49 candidate checks. The typed registry adds no standalone value beyond direct order-aware risk plus repair; recommend merge/drop pending human review.

final_parent_mechanism.zh: 回滚等价的更新历史压缩

terminal_reason.zh: 放弃多个祖先更新同时定位的旧弱场景，转为长期顺序 update history 的压缩、顺序依赖保持与 selective rollback。
terminal_reason.en: Drop the old simultaneous multi-ancestor localization setting and focus on compaction of long sequential update history while preserving order dependencies and selective rollback.

pre_p0_gate.zh: 预注册顺序更新流、storage/replay 预算与 12 个冻结 rollback queries。
pre_p0_gate.en: Preregister the sequential update stream, storage/replay budget, and 12 frozen rollback queries.

strongest_baseline.zh: 相同 storage/replay budget 的 periodic checkpoints。
strongest_baseline.en: Periodic checkpoints at matched storage/replay budget.

minimum_p0.zh: 30–50 sequential updates + 12 frozen rollback queries，测 rollback fidelity、accumulated gain 与压缩率。
minimum_p0.en: 30–50 sequential updates plus 12 frozen rollback queries measuring rollback fidelity, accumulated gain, and compaction.

exact_stop.zh: periodic checkpoint 同预算达到相同 rollback fidelity，或需要接近 full history 才能正确 rollback，则停止。
exact_stop.en: Stop if matched-budget periodic checkpoints reach the same rollback fidelity or near-full history is required for correct rollback.

current_fact.zh: A-5 CPU P0 已触发 matched-simplification STOP：40 个 sequential updates、12 个冻结 rollback queries 上，semantic compactor 与 query-matched generic state-diff 都为 12/12 rollback fidelity=1.0、平均 replay 段数同为 6.5；generic 不使用 Prompt/Memory/Workflow 语义，只需 38 storage cells，而 semantic compactor 需 73。相同约 72-cell 预算的 periodic checkpoint 同样 12/12，平均只 replay 2.25 updates。Agent-specific semantic history compaction 没有独立优势，建议并回通用版本/状态差分基础设施，等待人工确认 merge/drop。
current_fact.en: A-5 CPU P0 fired a matched-simplification STOP. Across 40 sequential updates and 12 frozen rollback queries, the semantic compactor and a query-matched generic state-diff baseline both achieve 12/12 rollback fidelity=1.0 with identical 6.5 mean replay segments. The generic baseline uses no Prompt/Memory/Workflow semantics and needs only 38 storage cells versus 73 for semantic compaction. A periodic-checkpoint baseline at roughly the same 72-cell budget also achieves 12/12 and replays only 2.25 updates on average. Agent-specific semantic history compaction has no standalone advantage and should merge into generic version/state-diff infrastructure pending human merge/drop review.

terminal_reason.zh: 真实实验为 matched-simplification-tie，hidden effect≈0.0139；same-outcome process invariance 不再独立成论文。
terminal_reason.en: Real experiments produced a matched-simplification tie with hidden effect ≈0.0139; same-outcome process invariance is no longer standalone.

exact_stop.zh: 已触发 merge；不得换名复活。
exact_stop.en: Merge has fired; do not revive under a new name.

terminal_reason.zh: 只保留 matched-budget deletion 后可重复翻转结论的 representative entries。
terminal_reason.en: Retain representative entries only when matched-budget deletion reproducibly flips a conclusion.

pre_p0_gate.zh: ≥30 reproducible conclusion-changing cases；与 NLI/utility selection 的 Jaccard 均<0.7；扣除 calibration cost 后净收益>0；hidden E_orig 前冻结 buffer。
pre_p0_gate.en: >=30 reproducible conclusion-changing cases; Jaccard<0.7 versus NLI and utility selections; positive net benefit after calibration cost; freeze the buffer before hidden E_orig.

strongest_baseline.zh: 完全匹配 representative/calibration budget 的 contradiction-aware NLI 与 utility retention。
strongest_baseline.en: Contradiction-aware NLI and utility retention with fully matched representative/calibration budgets.

minimum_p0.zh: matched deletion 建立 conclusion-change set，冻结后在 hidden E_orig paired before/after。
minimum_p0.en: Build the conclusion-change set with matched deletion, freeze it, then run paired before/after on hidden E_orig.

exact_stop.zh: 任一 disagreement/cost gate 不过直接 DROP，不再修。
exact_stop.en: If any disagreement/cost gate fails, DROP directly with no further repair.

current_fact.zh: B-2 当前共享 Memory substrate/data 实例触发支持门 STOP：完整 72-unit 表只有 11 个 controlled-nonzero memory effects，且专门的 conclusion-change deletion cases 为 0，无法满足冻结的 ≥30 reproducible conclusion-changing cases 前置门。STOP_CURRENT_SUBSTRATE_CONCLUSION_CHANGE_SUPPORT_INSUFFICIENT 只停止当前数据实例，不授权 B-2 方法 FAIL；hidden E_orig 不得打开。
current_fact.en: The current B-2 shared-memory substrate/data instance fires a support-gate STOP: the complete 72-unit table contains only 11 controlled-nonzero memory effects and zero dedicated conclusion-change deletion cases, so it cannot satisfy the frozen >=30 reproducible conclusion-changing-case prerequisite. STOP_CURRENT_SUBSTRATE_CONCLUSION_CHANGE_SUPPORT_INSUFFICIENT stops only this data instance and does not authorize a B-2 method failure; hidden E_orig must remain sealed.

terminal_reason.zh: 先筛 top-M，再只对少量候选随机化 retrieval/content/rank/co-retrieval，判断 harm pathway 并映射到 quarantine/rewrite/rank-cap/mutex。
terminal_reason.en: Screen top-M first, randomize retrieval/content/rank/co-retrieval only for a small candidate set, identify the harm pathway, and map it to quarantine/rewrite/rank-cap/mutex.

pre_p0_gate.zh: 冻结 top-M 筛选、matched audit cost、随机化层级和 repair action set；禁止全 memory 完整三臂 replay。
pre_p0_gate.en: Freeze top-M screening, matched audit cost, randomization hierarchy, and repair actions; forbid exhaustive three-arm replay over all memories.

strongest_baseline.zh: per-item causal selector + simple co-occurrence exclusion，matched audit cost。
strongest_baseline.en: Per-item causal selector plus simple co-occurrence exclusion at matched audit cost.

minimum_p0.zh: 定位路径后做持久修复，冻结后在 future reuse 上评估净收益与干预样本效率。
minimum_p0.en: Apply persistent repair after pathway localization, then freeze and evaluate future-reuse net benefit and intervention sample efficiency.

exact_stop.zh: 路径分解不优于 matched per-item/co-occurrence baseline 则停止路径机制主张。
exact_stop.en: Stop the pathway claim if decomposition does not beat matched per-item/co-occurrence controls.

current_fact.zh: B-3 synthetic matched-cost screening 曾给出 pathway signal，但真实 fresh reality gate 的 substrate support 不足：先前 v1 的 6 targets 中 5/6 与旧 Memory full-support target scenarios 重叠，已标 INVALID_TARGET_OVERLAP_DEVELOPMENT_ONLY 并停止；按严格 fresh contract 排除 source scenarios、全部旧 target scenarios 与重复 target 后，四个 source family 仅剩 0/3/1/1，共 5 个 executable fresh scenarios < 冻结 6-pair gate。触发 STOP_CURRENT_SUBSTRATE_FRESH_CINTERACTION_SUPPORT_INSUFFICIENT；不授权 B-3 方法 FAIL。
current_fact.en: B-3 synthetic matched-cost screening produced a pathway signal, but the real fresh-reality substrate lacks support. Five of six targets in the first v1 run overlapped prior Memory full-support target scenarios, so that run was marked INVALID_TARGET_OVERLAP_DEVELOPMENT_ONLY and stopped. Under the strict fresh contract excluding source scenarios, all prior target scenarios, and duplicate targets, the four source families expose only 0/3/1/1 = 5 executable fresh scenarios, below the frozen six-pair gate. STOP_CURRENT_SUBSTRATE_FRESH_CINTERACTION_SUPPORT_INSUFFICIENT fires; a B-3 method failure is not authorized.

terminal_reason.en: Freeze the skill body/predicate vocabulary and learn only a compact external applicability gate; counterexamples may only minimally and monotonically shrink applicability while protecting old positives.

pre_p0_gate.zh: 冻结 skill body、predicate vocabulary、complexity budget 与 old-positive protection set。
pre_p0_gate.en: Freeze the skill body, predicate vocabulary, complexity budget, and old-positive protection set.

strongest_baseline.en: Complexity-matched ILP and precondition-only learner.

minimum_p0.zh: 反例驱动最小单调收缩，同时评估 held-out boundary cases 与 old positives。
minimum_p0.en: Use counterexample-driven minimal monotone shrinking and evaluate held-out boundary cases together with old positives.

exact_stop.zh: 同复杂度 baseline 等效则停止独立 monotone/generalization claim。
exact_stop.en: Stop the standalone monotone/generalization claim if a complexity-matched baseline is equivalent.

current_fact.zh: B-5 CPU P0 已触发 matched-simplification STOP：冻结同一 skill body/predicate vocabulary、counterexamples、old-positive set 与 complexity budget 后，monotone counterexample repair 与 complexity-matched exhaustive ILP/precondition learner 在 12/12 skills 上学习到完全相同的 gate，held-out boundary 与 old-positive 指标逐项相同；双方 true-gate recovery 都为 10/12，连失败 case 也完全一致。独立 monotone/generalization claim 被同复杂度 ILP 完整复现，建议 merge/drop，等待人工确认。
current_fact.en: B-5 CPU P0 fired a matched-simplification STOP. With the same frozen skill body/predicate vocabulary, counterexamples, old-positive set, and complexity budget, monotone counterexample repair and a complexity-matched exhaustive ILP/precondition learner produce exactly the same gate on all 12 skills and identical held-out-boundary/old-positive metrics. Both recover the true gate on 10/12 skills and fail the same cases. The standalone monotone/generalization claim is fully reproduced by a matched ILP baseline; recommend merge/drop pending human review.

final_parent_mechanism.zh: 复用机会驱动的记忆效用复验

terminal_reason.zh: 放弃时间 half-life；固定审计 20% activation，用 matched memory ON/OFF replay 估 local utility drift，训练 frozen utility-hazard model。
terminal_reason.en: Drop temporal half-life; audit a fixed 20% of activations with matched memory ON/OFF replay to estimate local utility drift and train a frozen utility-hazard model.

pre_p0_gate.zh: 冻结 20% activation audit、replay budget、hazard features 与 retire/quarantine/revalidate rule。
pre_p0_gate.en: Freeze the 20% activation audit, replay budget, hazard features, and retire/quarantine/revalidate rule.

strongest_baseline.zh: 同一 20% audit/replay budget 的 TTL、LRU、LFU、recency+frequency。
strongest_baseline.en: TTL, LRU, LFU, and recency+frequency under the same 20% audit/replay budget.

minimum_p0.zh: 在真实 reuse opportunities 上估 intervention utility drift，冻结后评估 future reuse harm/benefit 与成本。
minimum_p0.en: Estimate intervention utility drift at real reuse opportunities, freeze, then evaluate future-reuse harm/benefit and cost.

exact_stop.zh: simple cache policy 同预算等效则只保留 cache component。
exact_stop.en: If a simple cache policy is equivalent at matched budget, retain only a cache component.

current_fact.zh: B-6 CPU P0 已触发更强的 matched-simplification STOP：12 memories×25 reuse opportunities，固定每 5 次 activation 审计一次，严格 20%=60/300 matched ON/OFF labels。learned utility-hazard 在 240 future reuse 上仍漏留 16 个 harmful memory；同一 audit 标签调出的 recency>=4 && frequency<=2 simple rule 为 0 harmful retained、0 beneficial quarantine，保留 benefit 同为 192。simple recency+frequency policy 严格支配 learned hazard，因此只保留 cache/revalidation component，等待人工 merge/drop。
current_fact.en: B-6 CPU P0 fired a stronger matched-simplification STOP. Across 12 memories × 25 reuse opportunities, every fifth activation is audited, giving exactly 20%=60/300 matched ON/OFF utility labels. On 240 future reuse events, the learned utility-hazard model still retains 16 harmful memories, while a recency>=4 && frequency<=2 rule tuned on the identical audit labels retains zero harmful memories, quarantines zero beneficial memories, and retains the same 192 beneficial events. The simple recency+frequency policy strictly dominates the learned hazard; retain only a cache/revalidation component pending human merge/drop review.

final_parent_mechanism.zh: 并入 B-5 的 compact external applicability gate
final_parent_mechanism.en: Merged into B-5 compact external applicability gate

title.zh: 谱系条件伪标签隔离器

revival.changed_assumption: Repeated self-labels from one ancestor are correlated evidence; learn persistent lineage-conditioned discount/quarantine rather than confidence flow.

strongest_baseline.en: Same-feature capacity-matched direct history classifier plus confidence, EMA-teacher, and simple source-discount rules.

pre_p0_gate.en: Require same-ancestor error enrichment beyond confidence-matched independent sources and >=20% held-out decision disagreement versus the strongest direct baseline.

minimum_p0.en: Freeze 4-6 rounds and >=200 lineage-linked label decisions; hold out ancestors and later rounds; compare false accepts, clean-label retention, and next-round utility at matched accepted count.

substrate_inventory.target_variation_rule: correct/incorrect labels from repeated and independent lineages

current_fact.en: Standalone B-8 escalation is stopped and a clean R1 is not authorized. The old shared P0 remains SUPPORT_INSUFFICIENT_METHOD_INCONCLUSIVE plus PROVENANCE_INCONCLUSIVE and must not be rewritten as an old-method FAIL. A later CPU-only failure diagnosis explains why the principle can look right while the gate remains unlearnable: retrieved versus token-matched placebo diverges significantly earlier on nonzero-effect units. On matched physical RTX3090 regeneration, the first-divergence index reproduces for 11/11 original nonzero units and the exact first-divergent action pair for 10/11, ruling out pure stochastic noise. Yet state-signature localization is weak (only 3.46% Brier improvement over the best task baseline; MI permutation p=0.216). The same memory se-m-pick_cool_then_place_in_recep-1 yields -1/+1/-1 on cool/heat/clean targets under the identical index-0 pre_acquire|navigate>navigate signature. The best current explanation is reproducible early trajectory-branch steering whose downstream context determines benefit versus harm, so the candidate-global replicated-effect assumption was too strong. This diagnosis does not revive B-8 or auto-authorize a replacement idea. Operationally, retain this only as a soft audit-priority signal: a 1-step screen uses about 25% of paired-rollout cost and captures 54.5% of nonzero effects, but reaching 90.9% recall at 5 steps already costs about 90.1%. It may prioritize audit order but must never hard-exclude confirmatory cases.

current_fact.zh: B-9 standalone 已停止，strict-LOTO 仅保留为 archived secondary diagnostic。旧结果仍是 TRANSPORT_SUPPORT_INSUFFICIENT，不是方法 FAIL。后续 first-divergence diagnosis 进一步表明，memory effect 的可复现部分主要是“早期 trajectory branch 被稳定改变”，而不是可由 local state/task signature 稳定预测的最终 effect sign：11 个 nonzero unit 的同卡 regeneration 首分叉位置 11/11 复现、action pair 10/11 复现，但完全相同的早期 signature 可在不同 target context 下翻转 sign。因而 B-9 的 task-level effect transport 假设也过强；当前不授权 clean R1、formal-method、第二 backbone 或自动替代 idea。 工程上仅保留为 soft audit-priority signal：1-step 约 25% paired-rollout 成本可覆盖 54.5% nonzero effects，但达到 90.9% recall 时 5-step 成本已约 90.1%；因此只能用于审计排序，禁止作为 hard gate 淘汰 confirmatory cases。
current_fact.en: Standalone B-9 is stopped; strict LOTO remains only as an archived secondary diagnostic. The old result remains TRANSPORT_SUPPORT_INSUFFICIENT, not a method FAIL. The later first-divergence diagnosis shows that the reproducible component of memory effect is mainly stable early trajectory-branch steering rather than a final effect sign that is stable under local-state or task signatures: matched-hardware regeneration reproduces the first-divergence index for 11/11 nonzero units and the action pair for 10/11, while an identical early signature can flip sign across downstream target contexts. The task-level effect-transport assumption was therefore also too strong. Clean R1, formal-method work, a second backbone, and automatic replacement-idea creation remain unauthorized. Operationally, retain this only as a soft audit-priority signal: a 1-step screen uses about 25% of paired-rollout cost and captures 54.5% of nonzero effects, but reaching 90.9% recall at 5 steps already costs about 90.1%. It may prioritize audit order but must never hard-exclude confirmatory cases.

title.zh: 限探针 API 转移算子

current_fact.zh: E-3 已完成两层 P0：先在 GitLab/Codeberg 无泄漏 read-only reality P0 上 deterministic P/E/X 12/12；随后补 stateful side-effect/recovery harness，ledger/vault 两个不同状态码 family 各 N=6 probes，hidden create/update/delete、duplicate，以及跨操作的 stale-update→hidden stale-delete、missing-delete→hidden missing-update，共 12/12 final-state + recovery 精确。read-only 与 state-changing E 两层都被同构 deterministic P/E/X ceiling，触发 STOP_STATEFUL_DETERMINISTIC_PEX_CEILING；learned arm 不再运行，等待人工 DROP/merge。
current_fact.en: E-3 completed two P0 layers: first a leakage-free read-only reality P0 on GitLab/Codeberg where deterministic P/E/X scored 12/12; then a stateful side-effect/recovery harness with ledger/vault as two distinct status-code families, N=6 probes each, and hidden create/update/delete, duplicate, plus cross-operation stale-update→hidden stale-delete and missing-delete→hidden missing-update cases. The deterministic isomorphic P/E/X baseline again achieved 12/12 exact final-state plus recovery semantics. Both read-only and state-changing E layers are at ceiling, firing STOP_STATEFUL_DETERMINISTIC_PEX_CEILING; the learned arm is not run and E-3 awaits human DROP/merge review.

title.zh: 固定上限下的干预式权限重授权筛选
title.en: Interventional Permission Triage Under a Fixed Ceiling

current_fact.zh: E-4 executable permission CPU P0 已收口：在 train/test mutation feature combinations 0 重叠的 32 个 unseen operators 上，线性 q 虽以 0 missed-risk 将重授权从 deterministic envelope 的 72 降到 53，但同一 mutation representation + 同一 intervention labels 的 monotone-DNF 简单规则同样 0 missed-risk，只需 29 次重授权。触发 STOP_MATCHED_BOOLEAN_RULE_EQUIVALENT；learned q 独立机制不再保留，等待人工 DROP/merge。
current_fact.en: E-4 executable-permission CPU P0 is closed: on 32 unseen operators with zero overlap between train and test mutation feature combinations, the linear q reduces reauthorizations from 72 for the deterministic envelope to 53 at zero missed risk, but a monotone-DNF simplification induced from the identical mutation representation and intervention labels also has zero missed risk and needs only 29 reauthorizations. STOP_MATCHED_BOOLEAN_RULE_EQUIVALENT fires; the learned-q mechanism is not retained as a standalone method and awaits human DROP/merge review.

title.zh: 约束完备的类型化记忆顺序逻辑

current_fact.zh: CPU P0 已触发预注册 STOP：32 个全部含有效约束的 held-out 类型组合上，symbolic 与匹配 typed n-ary factor 的 exact accuracy 均为 1.00；将 factor 编译控制限制到与 symbolic 相同 active-edge budget 后，compiled accuracy 仍 1.00 vs 1.00，平均 edge checks 同为 1.125。独立符号表征/编译优势均被 matched simplification 复现，不建议再耗 GPU；等待人工确认 DROP/merge。
current_fact.en: CPU P0 fired the preregistered STOP. Across 32 held-out type combinations with binding constraints, symbolic and matched typed n-ary factor exact accuracy are both 1.00; after matching the factor compiled control to the same active-edge budget, compiled accuracy remains 1.00 vs 1.00 with identical 1.125 mean edge checks. Both standalone symbolic-representation and compilation advantages are reproduced by the matched simplification, so no GPU expansion is recommended; await human DROP/merge review.

current_fact.zh: CPU P0 已触发 matched-simplification STOP：24 个冻结 4–8-update 稀疏故障案例上，active-causal 与非学习 binary group testing 均 100% 找到最小故障集，平均测试次数逐 case 完全一致（5.708 vs 5.708，paired p=1.0）。相对 ddmin 的 62% 节省来自换成了更适合稀疏故障的标准 group testing，而不是独立学习机制；不建议再耗真实序列/GPU，等待人工确认 DROP/merge。
current_fact.en: CPU P0 fired a matched-simplification STOP. Across 24 frozen 4–8-update sparse-fault cases, active-causal and non-learning binary group testing both recover the exact minimal fault set on 100% of cases with identical per-case intervention counts (5.708 vs 5.708 mean tests, paired p=1.0). The apparent 62% saving over ddmin comes from switching to standard sparse group testing rather than a distinct learned mechanism; no real-sequence/GPU expansion is recommended, pending human DROP/merge review.

title.zh: 反事实进化决策控制器

current_fact.zh: A-7 CPU same-state four-action P0 已触发 matched-simplification STOP：hidden table 中 continue/commit/rollback/stop 分别有 6/2/6/2 个最优动作，线性 counterfactual controller 16/16、mean/worst regret=0；但仅用同四个原始 state features、由 train/calibration 选择的 depth-3 CART（13 nodes）同样 16/16、regret=0，四动作分布完全一致。counterfactual table 仍可作为 A-2 的诊断/简单决策规则，但 standalone learned-controller 主张被浅规则完全复现，不建议再做真实四动作 GPU replay，等待人工确认 merge/drop。
current_fact.en: A-7 CPU same-state four-action P0 fired a matched-simplification STOP. The hidden table supports all actions with optimal counts continue/commit/rollback/stop = 6/2/6/2. The linear counterfactual controller reaches 16/16 with zero mean/worst regret, but a depth-3 CART with only the same four raw state features, selected using train/calibration only, also reaches 16/16 and zero regret with the identical action distribution. The counterfactual table remains useful as A-2 diagnostic/simple decision-rule evidence, but the standalone learned-controller claim is fully reproduced by a shallow rule; no real four-action GPU replay is recommended pending human merge/drop review.
